sections.title: The dashboard
sections.body: The home of Orbis Stream: from here you reach live management, the preview, the layouts, the history and the settings.
steps: Open a card to enter a section.
The same areas are always one click away in the sidebar on the left.
sections.callout: Open a card to enter that area.

sections.title: Start a live
sections.body: Open Live and press Start live: Orbis asks which video/audio setting goes on air and on which channel, then opens the canvas to compose the scene.
steps: The highlighted button opens the wizard for a new live.
Confirm at the end to go on air.

sections.title: The start wizard
sections.body: Two steps: the first picks the video and audio setting, the second the channel to stream to. Next goes forward, Back returns.
steps: Choose the setting of the live.
Choose the channel (for TikTok, type the key of the live too).
Compose / Next opens the canvas.
sections.callout: Next moves to the second step.

sections.title: Stream a folder (playlist)
sections.body: Instead of a single scene you can stream every video of a folder, one after another.
steps: Press Start playlist.
Choose setting and channel, then the folder of videos.
Confirm to go on air.
sections.callout: Start playlist streams a whole folder in sequence.

sections.title: Compose the scene
sections.body: The canvas is where a live is assembled: drop your sources (screen, window, camera, audio) into the slots, then add overlays on top.
steps: Add a source to a slot.
Add or drop overlays and arrange them.
Confirm to start the live.
sections.callout: The canvas: sources in the slots, overlays on top.

sections.title: The scene deck
sections.body: The scene deck puts a video, a banner or an image on air in place of the live, the way a studio switches scene. Every button can carry a name and a keyboard shortcut.
steps: Open the deck from a live row or the preview.
Press a button to take it on air; Resume live brings the live back.
sections.callout: The scene deck switches what is on air.

sections.title: The preview
sections.body: The preview shows what a live is broadcasting right now, with the health of the stream, the bitrate and the frame rate.
steps: Watch the live and its data.
Open the scene deck or stop the live from here.
sections.callout: The live on air, as it is being sent.

sections.title: Layouts
sections.body: A layout is the skeleton of a live: the slots and the overlays, saved under a name to be reused. The wizard opens a layout as its slots.
steps: Press New layout.
Draw the slots and the overlays, then save it.
sections.callout: New layout opens the canvas to draw a reusable scene.

sections.title: Live history
sections.body: Every live you started is kept here with its platform, channel, folder and outcome.
steps: Start the same live again, or open its details.
Play a spot, link a setting, or delete the row.
sections.callout: The lives you started, ready to start again.

sections.title: Task manager
sections.body: How the PC is doing: CPU, RAM, disks, network, GPU, the temperatures and the FFmpeg processes of the live.
steps: Watch the meters while a live runs.
Check that the machine keeps up with the stream.
sections.callout: Resources and FFmpeg activity, in real time.

sections.title: Settings
sections.body: Under Settings you find the video and audio settings, the channels, the theme, the language and this guide. The sidebar carries the theme, the language and About from anywhere.
steps: Video & audio: create the settings and activate those allowed on air.
Channels: add the platforms and their stream keys.
sections.callout: Settings groups video/audio, channels and this guide.
